title: L3M: A Verifiable Harness and Runtime for Self-Extending and Self-Improving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.19591v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The lasting gains in AI have come from methods that absorb more computation, and language models already scale computation within a call. Useful work, though, happens across calls: over hours or days, through tools and external systems, among many agents and the humans they work for, and increasingly through code the agents write themselves. Whether that work compounds is enabled by the harness around it, and the harness faces a constraint the model does not: of the three participants in such a computation, the human, the model and code, only the human's attention does not scale, so the computation can grow only if the human is not in every loop. L3M is a runtime built on that premise, written in Lean 4 so that one language implements the harness, states its invariants, and is the language agents extend it in. translated_title: L3M：一个用于自我扩展与自我改进智能体的可验证框架与运行时
translated_abstract: AI的持久性收益来自那些能够吸收更多计算量的方法，而语言模型已经能够在单次调用内扩展计算。然而，实际有用的工作发生在多次调用之间：跨越数小时或数天，通过工具和外部系统，在众多智能体及其服务的人类之间进行，并且越来越多地通过智能体自己编写的代码来实现。这些工作能否产生复合效应，取决于围绕它的框架，而该框架面临一个模型本身没有的约束：在人类、模型和代码这三类计算参与者中，只有人类的注意力无法扩展，因此只有当人类不必处于每个环节中时，计算才能持续增长。L3M正是基于这一前提构建的运行时系统，它使用Lean 4编写，使得同一种语言既实现了框架、又声明了其不变量，并且还是智能体用来扩展该系统的语言。一次计算贯穿人类、智能体、模型和代码，其全部状态都存放在Git中：形成丰富的状态轨迹，而不……
tldr: L3M用Lean 4构建了一个可验证的运行时框架，使自我扩展与自我改进的智能体能够跨越多次调用累积计算并产生复合收益，同时无需人类参与每个环节。
en_tdlr: L3M is a verifiable Lean 4 runtime harness that enables self-extending and self-improving agents to compound computation across calls without requiring humans in every loop.
